<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Alison is asking me to double-check a specific time slot: Thursday, November 19 at 10:00 AM. She says it works for Priya and Marcus. I need to verify if Elena and David are available at this time.

In my first session, I already checked this. My notes say: `Thu, Nov 19, 10:00 AM: Elena is busy. David is free. -> No`.

To be absolutely certain before I respond, I will read Elena Soto's calendar again, focusing on that specific day and time. I don't need to re-read David's, because if one of them is busy, the slot won't work.

Based on the calendar data I already have, Elena has a "Hiring panel" from 10:00-10:30 on Thursday. So the slot does not work.

Our combined efforts have shown:
1.  Alison's initial list of Priya/Marcus slots had no availability for Elena/David.
2.  My complete list of Elena/David slots had no availability for Priya/Marcus.

This means there is no 30-minute slot where all four partners are free next week. The task is infeasible.

My plan for this session:
1.  Read Elena Soto's calendar again to be 100% sure about the Thursday 10:00 AM slot.
2.  Append a message to the workspace confirming to Alison that the slot doesn't work and explaining that there are no common availabilities.
3.  Use the `report_infeasible` function to formally conclude that the meeting cannot be scheduled.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
